body.condition: Every singular value of \(Df(x)\) lies in \([K^{-1},K]\) for every \(x\in\mathbb T^n\).

novel.justification: Uniform singular-value bounds keep observed-law and latent-law norms mutually comparable and exclude Jacobian collapse as an alternative source of instability. The periodic shear family has determinant one and uniformly bounded map and inverse derivatives.
